description: Société des grands projets: rail datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Société des grands projets. Coverage: Société des grands projets. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about rail; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Temps de correspondance prévisionnels dans les gares; Noms et codes des gares; Ligne 15 Sud : Tracé et localisation des gares; Point de localisation des gares du Grand Paris Express. Formats seen: ZIP, XLS, CSV, KML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf), as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
